term.definition: In the Quadratic Formula, $$x = \frac{\text{−}b \pm \sqrt{b^{2} - 4ac}}{2a},$$ the quantity b2 − 4ac is called the discriminant.
A quadratic function, where a, b, and c are real numbers and $$a \neq 0,$$ is a function of the form $$f(x) = ax^{2} + bx + c.$$
A quadratic inequality is an inequality that contains a quadratic expression.
